ModMetaData.name: ProgressionLESS: Power
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
All the Progression goodness, less research.
Overhauls power research, so every generator, battery and power building has a place in the research tree.
The "LESS" is less research: Progression: Power adds up to N research projects depending on your mods. This fork groups them into at most M, such as A, B and C. Everything stays in the same era, and still needs the other research it did before.
Forked from Progression: Power by ferny. Huge thanks to ferny for the original mod and all the Progression work this builds on. Replaces the original; do not use both.
For a really good modpack, check out The Progression Modpack on the Steam Workshop.
